author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m trying out Blaklader’s new Epic safety boots. They’re lace-free with just a twist-dial, which is pretty cool. The composite safety toe, waterproof construction, and comfort are important if you’re on your feet all day. Gotta say, I’m impressed and recommend you check them out
title: Blaklader’s New Epic Safety Boot - #safetyboots #workwear #sponsored
